reasons.build: No root build script. apps/hq and apps/display are the only workspaces with a real build step; the Expo apps build through EAS, not locally.
reasons.format: n/a - no formatter is configured anywhere in the repo; ESLint with --max-warnings=0 is the only style gate.
reasons.coverage: Runs workspace TS/TSX coverage and enforces the pull-request-safe 40 percent line floor; hosted CI also merges database and browser coverage.
